desc: Bullpup style shotguns and AR-style shotguns have taken the shotgun market by storm in recent years, and with the Charles Daly Hydra 902 Combo, you can get the advantages of both systems in one package. This semi-automatic shotgun includes a complete upper assembly which can be snapped into either of two lower receivers so you can have either a compact bullpup style shotgun or a longer AR-style shotgun. Both configurations are fed from a 5-round detachable box magazine for fast reloads. The Hydra 902 has a 3" chamber, making it capable of accepting 2-3/4" shells as well as ultra hard-hitting 3" shells. A full length Picatinny rail on the top allows the user to attach a reflex sight or scope, and you can leave the optic on the upper when you swap it between the lowers. Why choose between a compact bullpup shotgun or an AR-style shotgun when you can get the best of both worlds?
